tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: The cooperative's brand colour (theme.ts `primary`). Filled buttons, selected chips and segments, header icons, home-tile icons, unread dots, user chat bubbles, the capital hero card, links. As text on `background`, `surface` and `surface-variant` (≥ 5.0:1 in every preset). On `primary-container` only for icons, 24 px+ text or bold 19 px+ (≥ 4.08:1 — amber is the weakest); small text there uses `on-primary-container`.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a `primary` fill (button labels, user bubbles, hero card). Every preset is server-checked to keep white at ≥ 4.5:1.

tokens.name: primary-container
tokens.usage: Brand mixed 85 % with white. Home tiles, info badges, selected vote card, assistant suggestion cards, tinted hero of the member area. Carries `on-primary-container`, `text` or `primary`.

tokens.name: on-primary-container
tokens.usage: Brand mixed 60 % with black. Text on `primary-container` (info badges, tile titles when tinted). ≥ 4.5:1 on `primary-container` in all 8 presets — fixes the unchecked `info` tone.

tokens.name: secondary
tokens.usage: Brand mixed 50 % with `muted`. Supporting icons (AI notice, source cards), outlined-chip borders, the identity line under the home title. As text only on `background`/`surface` (≥ 4.5:1 in every preset).

tokens.name: secondary-container
tokens.usage: Alias of `primary-container` (theme.ts derives both from the same mix). Paper uses it for selected SegmentedButtons and filter chips; this system fills selected controls with `primary` instead and keeps the container for tiles.

tokens.name: on-secondary-container
tokens.usage: Alias of `on-primary-container`: text on `secondary-container`.

tokens.name: elevation-1
tokens.usage: Brand 5 % on white (MD3 tonal elevation level 1). Pressed state of white cards and tiles; skeleton shimmer highlight.

tokens.name: elevation-2
tokens.usage: Brand 8 % on white (level 2). Header background when content is scrolled under it; sticky confirm bar; search-field background.

tokens.name: elevation-3
tokens.usage: Brand 11 % on white (level 3). Menus and the invitation-link card.

tokens.name: elevation-4
tokens.usage: Brand 12 % on white (level 4). Reserved by Paper for navigation surfaces; unused in the app today.

tokens.name: elevation-5
tokens.usage: Brand 14 % on white (level 5). Pressed state of tinted tiles; the biometric-lock overlay background. Text on it stays `text` (≥ 4.5:1).

tokens.name: background
tokens.usage: Page background of every screen (MD3 `background`). Light theme only.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, header, bottom bars (MD3 `surface`). Same as `background`; cards are separated by `border`, not shade.

tokens.name: surface-variant
tokens.usage: theme.ts fixed `surface`. Assistant chat bubbles, neutral badges, skeleton blocks, disabled-looking read-only fields, AI notices. Carries `text` and `muted`.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Body text and titles on `background`, `surface`, `surface-variant`, `primary-container`, `warning-container`, `danger-container` and `elevation-1…5` (≥ 4.5:1 everywhere).

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: meta lines, hints, empty-state copy, placeholders; outline of inputs, chips and outlined buttons (MD3 `outline` / `onSurfaceVariant`). As text on `background`, `surface` and `surface-variant` (6.0:1 and 5.6:1). On `primary-container` it holds ≥ 4.6:1, but prefer `on-primary-container` there.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Dividers, card hairlines, list separators, segmented-button and vote-card resting borders (MD3 `outlineVariant`). Decorative only: never text, never the sole signal of state.

tokens.name: disabled-container
tokens.usage: Fill of a disabled filled button or switch track (`text` at 12 %, MD3).

tokens.name: disabled-text
tokens.usage: Label and icon of any disabled control (`text` at 38 %, MD3). Pair it with `disabled-container` or `background` only.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Backdrop behind menus and the biometric-lock overlay (`text` at 32 %). Native dialogs bring their own.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Fixed red: error text, destructive buttons (`Retirar`, `Anular`, `Cerrar sesión`), overdue text, negative money, `Vencida`/`Retirado`/`Cancelada` badge text. As text on `background`, `surface` (6.5:1) and `danger-container` (5.5:1).

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Text on a `danger` fill: danger button labels and the CountBadge number (6.5:1).

tokens.name: danger-container
tokens.usage: Fixed. Background of danger badges and the error strip of an invoice row; behind `danger` text only.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Fixed amber: warning text and badge text (`Borrador`, `Abierta`, `Con discrepancia`, `Vence hoy`), the ⚠ of a low-confidence AI field. As text on `background`, `surface` (≥ 6.1:1) and `warning-container` (6.1:1).

tokens.name: warning-container
tokens.usage: Fixed. Background of warning badges and amber banners (`N facturas con discrepancia sin resolver.`); behind `warning` or `text`.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Alias of `primary`: the `info` badge tone and the `Conciliada`/`Convocada`/`Aprobado` family. Text colour of info badges is `on-primary-container`, not this.

tokens.name: info-container
tokens.usage: Alias of `primary-container`: background of info badges (`Fijado`, `Convocada`, `Pendiente`, `Conciliada`, `Aprobado`, `Proveedor`/`Cliente`).

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Alias of `primary`: inline links (`Ver ficha del tercero`, `Abrir el existente`, `Ver socios`). Underline on web, none on native.

tokens.name: unread
tokens.usage: Alias of `primary`: the 10 px unread dot before an announcement title; always paired with a bold title, never alone.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Web keyboard focus: a solid 2 px ring of this colour, 2 px outside the control, on every surface it lands on (≥ 3:1 on white in all presets).

tokens.name: skeleton
tokens.usage: Alias of `surface-variant`: resting colour of skeleton blocks; the shimmer sweeps to `elevation-1`.

families.sans: system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif

styles.name: displaySmall
styles.usage: Only the capital amount on the `Mi capital` hero card and the two summary cards of the invoice list. Use tabular figures.

styles.name: headlineLarge
styles.usage: Login and invitation titles; `Voto registrado` and `Acceso activado` success screens.

styles.name: headlineMedium
styles.usage: The greeting on `Select cooperative`; the cooperative name on the home header at 960 wide.

styles.name: headlineSmall
styles.usage: Detail-screen titles (announcement title, assembly type, invoice number, member name); summary-card amounts.

styles.name: titleLarge
styles.usage: Header title of every screen (Paper Appbar.Content).

styles.name: titleMedium
styles.usage: Section headings inside a screen, home-tile titles, list-row titles, card titles, the AI-notice title.

styles.name: titleSmall
styles.usage: Sub-headings: `Fuentes` under an answer, `Movimientos`, group headers of the documents list.

styles.name: bodyLarge
styles.sample: Entra con el email y la contraseña de tu cooperativa.
styles.usage: The default body size: announcement text, assembly point descriptions, chat messages, form input text, empty-state copy. Chosen over bodyMedium because the typical member may be older.

styles.name: bodyMedium
styles.usage: Meta lines under titles, helper and error text under fields, source-card excerpts, notes (`Fecha cambiada el …`).

styles.name: bodySmall
styles.sample: La votación es consultiva y de apoyo a la asamblea presencial.
styles.usage: Fine print: the permanent vote note, attachment sizes, `Editado el …`, version history rows. Never below 12 px.

styles.name: labelLarge
styles.usage: Button labels, chips, segmented buttons, tab-like controls, source-card titles, `Tu voto: A favor`.

styles.name: labelMedium
styles.usage: Badge text (22 px pill), field counters `(n/120)`, progress labels.

styles.name: labelSmall
styles.usage: The CountBadge number only. Nothing else goes under 12 px.

spacing.note: A 4-pt scale proposed by this system; the app has no scale yet. Current values map exactly: screen padding 24 = space-6, block gap 16 = space-4, list padding 16 = space-4, home-grid gap 12 = space-3. The one change: the list gap moves from 10 to 12 (space-3).

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between a badge and its neighbour; between an icon and its label inside a chip.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Badge horizontal padding; gap between stacked badges and meta lines; gap between chips.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Home-grid gap; list gap between row cards (was 10); gap between a leading icon and its text; chat bubble vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Block gap inside a screen; card padding; list horizontal padding; chat bubble horizontal padding; gap between fields in a form.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Padding of the hero card and summary cards; space above a section heading.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Screen padding (left, right, top); gap between form sections; space under the AppLogo.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Space above a form's submit block; between the login fields and the footer note; padding of empty and error states.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Top padding of the login and invitation screens; the home-tile icon size as a layout step.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Bottom padding above the sticky confirm bar; height of the touch-target row.

radius.note: Paper's MD3 roundness is 4, so TextInput = 4, Chip = 8, Card = 12, Button = pill; the app's own values (vote option 12, chat bubble 14) are kept exactly.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Outlined TextInput and DateField; inner corners of SegmentedButtons; skeleton text lines.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Chips, source cards, attachment cards, AI notices, the FieldGroup frame, summary cards' inner elements.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards, home tiles, vote option cards, list row cards, banners, suggested-question cards.

tokens.name: radius-bubble
tokens.usage: Chat bubbles only (the app's current value); the corner nearest the sender stays 4 px.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: The `Mi capital` hero card, the two invoice summary cards, the sticky confirm bar's top corners.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Buttons (MD3 full pill), badges, CountBadge, progress bars, switch track and thumb, the unread dot.

shadow.note: Elevation is tonal first (the `elevation-n` colours); shadows are kept faint so iOS does not look like an Android port. Cards at rest have a `border` hairline and no shadow.

tokens.name: shadow-1
tokens.usage: MD3 level 1: pressed cards and tiles, the invitation-link card.

tokens.name: shadow-2
tokens.usage: MD3 level 2: the sticky confirm bar of the register form; the composer bar of the assistant.

tokens.name: shadow-3
tokens.usage: MD3 level 3: menus and the biometric-lock sheet.

size.note: Fixed dimensions the brief enforces, as tokens so previews and mockups share them.

tokens.name: size-control
tokens.usage: Minimum height of every button, segmented button, list row and vote card; MD3 TextInput is 56.

tokens.name: size-field
tokens.usage: Height of outlined TextInput and DateField.

tokens.name: size-header-icon
tokens.usage: HeaderAction hit area (44×44) around a 24 px icon.

tokens.name: size-icon
tokens.usage: Default icon size in headers, rows, chips and buttons.

tokens.name: size-icon-tile
tokens.usage: Home-tile icon.

tokens.name: size-icon-empty
tokens.usage: Icon of an empty or error state.

tokens.name: size-logo
tokens.usage: AppLogo mark on login and invitation.

tokens.name: size-badge
tokens.usage: Badge pill height.

tokens.name: size-count-badge
tokens.usage: CountBadge minimum width and height.

tokens.name: size-chip
tokens.usage: Chip height (MD3); SegmentedButtons are 40 high, padded to a 48 row.

tokens.name: size-composer-max
tokens.usage: Maximum height the chat composer grows to.

layout.note: Portrait only; phone first 360–430 wide; the web build centres content.

tokens.name: layout-max-width
tokens.usage: Maximum content width on web; the page background stays `background` edge to edge.

tokens.name: layout-phone
tokens.usage: Design width for every phone frame.

tokens.name: layout-grid-2
tokens.usage: Home grid: 2 columns from 0 wide.

tokens.name: layout-grid-3
tokens.usage: Home grid: 3 columns from 600 wide.

tokens.name: layout-grid-4
tokens.usage: Home grid: 4 columns from 840 wide.

tokens.name: layout-bubble-max
tokens.usage: Maximum width of a chat bubble.

tokens.name: opacity-pending
tokens.usage: A chat message while it is being sent.

tokens.name: opacity-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled icons and text (MD3).

tokens.name: opacity-pressed
tokens.usage: MD3 state layer of `primary` over a pressed outlined control.
